# Component setup — ultra-modern-lovable-style

## Initial setup
```bash
npx shadcn-ui@latest init
npm i vaul cmdk @paper-design/shaders-react gsap @studio-freight/lenis
```

## Adding shadcn primitives
```bash
npx shadcn-ui@latest add button card dialog tabs tooltip input textarea
```

## Adding Aceternity components
1. Visit ui.aceternity.com → find component (bento-grid, background-gradient, tracing-beam, card-hover-effect)
2. Copy TSX into `components/ui/` directory
3. Ensure tailwind.config.js has required animations (Aceternity provides them)

## Vaul drawer (mobile)
```tsx
import { Drawer } from 'vaul'
```

## CMDK command palette (Cmd+K)
```tsx
import { Command } from 'cmdk'
// Wrap in dialog from shadcn
```
